rename.to: CI, bazel-nightly: TF, TF serving, and bazel-tests are failing

body: The first failure in Tensorflow is https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/issues/15137
The other error in "re2/BUILD:97" was fixed here: https://github.com/google/re2/commit/884287d109ec987e8029ae0a9cebe66223283998
Marking this as non-blocker for #3773 because it's not a bug in Bazel, it requires updating some BUILD files.

I tested https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/2cf560f83922e6df9626ba3ee063c1caf6797548 locally. It fixes the `load()`-related errors on Windows in https://ci.bazel.io/job/Global/job/bazel-tests/383/consoleFull, but `//src/test/py/bazel:bazel_windows_cpp_test` and `//src/test/py/bazel:bazel_windows_test` are still failing. I'll file a separate issue.

repository.name: bazel

issue.body:
**This issue is blocking https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/3773**.

This bug is branched off https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/issues/4233#issuecomment-349679790 .

See https://ci.bazel.io/job/Global/job/bazel-tests/383/consoleFull
The test ran with a Bazel binary built at ddd5ac1.

I tested https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/commit/2cf560f83922e6df9626ba3ee063c1caf6797548 locally. It fixes the `load()`-related errors on Windows in https://ci.bazel.io/job/Global/job/bazel-tests/383/consoleFull, but `//src/test/py/bazel:bazel_windows_cpp_test` and `//src/test/py/bazel:bazel_windows_test` are still failing.
